title: 云海仙踪 第二卷 更隔蓬山一万重 八十二章 报仇云海仙踪 第二卷 更隔蓬山一万重八十三章 联手
slug: 云海仙踪更隔蓬山一万重
content_zh:
林灵素道：“我拿刀架住那狗杂种的脖子，问他还认不认得老子。他早认不出来了，连连摇头。我又提起我妹子和那对被他抢走的龙凤金锁，他这才脸色大变，连呼饶命，说我妹子是被那禁军都指挥使刘易知卖入了窑子，不干他的事。
“我脑子里‘嗡’的一响，肺都差点气炸了，一把掐住那狗杂种的脖子，将他被我咬剩的半只耳朵割了下来。那狗杂种嘶声惨叫，吓得尿屎齐流。奶奶的，老子只觉浑身热血全都冲到了头顶，从没这般快意过，他越是讨饶，我越要将他千刀万剐！
“我一刀接一刀，将他的双眼剜出，鼻子割去，手指、脚趾全都一根根斩断，又将他的五脏六腑绞碎掏了出来，抛到巷子里喂野狗。直到听见有人叫道：‘杀人啦！杀人啦！’‘官爷来啦！’这才罢手慢慢地走开。
“我在桃花洞、甜水巷、南北斜街又转悠了两天两夜，打探妹子的下落。从前欺凌过我的杂种，除了两个早死的，全都被我剥皮抽筋，大卸八块。
“嘿嘿，看着这些狗杂种恐惧求饶，那种爽快的滋味儿真是难以言喻。大丈夫在世，如果不能快意恩仇，活着又有什么兴味？只可惜那时老子太年轻，下手忒快忒重，不知道比起千刀万剐来，让人求生不得、求死不能更加解恨。”
黑暗中瞧不见他的表情，但听他桀桀怪笑着描述杀人的细节、折磨的手段，声音森冷阴狠，让人毛骨悚然。
众道士心头更是大凛，均想：“这厮睚眦必报，如果此番再让他脱身，我们一个也活不了。”
唯独许宣想起那些背叛、陷害许家的仇雠，怒火冲顶，心有戚戚，恨不能依法炮制，将他们一个个全都碎尸万段。
林灵素道：“我打听出刘易知的姘头叫小桃红，是海棠苑的头牌，于是就猫在曲院街的巷口，日夜等候。第三天夜里，那厮终于来了。过了二更，我让王文卿在巷里望风，翻身进了院子，顺着树干攀上了二楼。
“那姓刘的狗贼倒也刁滑，正搂着姘头呼呼大睡，听见声响立即翻身跃起，一把将小桃红朝我掷来。我一刀搠死那**，又唰唰两刀将那狗贼挥挡的太师椅劈断，顺势将他的右腕斩断。
“那狗贼翻滚着冲出窗外，纵声大叫，几个随从顿时从内院奔了出来。老子虽练了几个月的刀法，毕竟疏于实战，被这五个禁军卫士围攻，一时有些吃紧，好在逆鳞刀锋利无比，刀枪棍棒甫一交碰，立被削断。
“院里院外的灯一盏盏亮起来，妓女、龟公、嫖客探头观望，惊叫连连，有人更敲响金锣，大声呼救。
“刘易知捧着断腕跌跌撞撞地朝外冲去，我想要追赶，丹田却突然剧痛如绞。老子只顾着报仇，竟忘记了那天正好是七日之期。招式一乱，后背登时吃了一棒，接着胸口、右腿又被砍中，剧痛难支，摔倒在地。混乱中挥刀乱舞，劈死了两人，右肩又是一痛，被长枪钉穿在地。
“那三人齐声欢呼，举刀正待朝我砍下，突然身子一晃，全都仆倒在地。我又惊又奇，无暇多想，拔出长枪，忍痛冲出门去。却见那姓刘的狗贼蜷在巷口，王文卿握着那血淋淋的半截戒刀，满脸惊惶地站在一旁。嘿嘿，我传了他刀法，总算没有白费。
“刘易知被他迎面砍了一刀，奄奄一息。我揪起他喝问妹子的下落，那狗贼知道我是谁后，又是吃惊又是骇怒，咳嗽着笑道：‘你妹子被我送给和尚做庙妓，庙里青灯凉席，和尚们又没什么消遣，也不知道有没有命活到今天？’
“我听了大怒，问他是哪个寺庙，他却哈哈大笑，一头撞在我的刀口上，自己了结了狗命。远处马蹄声越来越近，至少有上百禁军朝这里赶来。我身负重伤，丹田内又疼得翻江倒海，一步也迈不开。
“王文卿背起我朝西疾奔。他别的本事稀疏寻常，逃命的本领倒是不错。经过永宁街，我迷迷糊糊想起严忘一就住在附近，以他的医术，定能救我性命，于是便让王娘子掉头朝南。
“严忘一虽然胆小吝啬，少与人往来，却独独将苏东坡、黄鲁直看作生死之交，爱屋及乌，对我们这些书童也算不错。深更半夜见我们浑身血污地跃进宅府，居然也没报官，只是慌里慌张地将我藏入内室，清创敷药。
“他把了一会儿脉，眉头越皱越深，连称奇怪，说我体内至少有六团炁丹相互冲克，脏腑受损极重，再这般下去，五行相克，迟早经脉尽断而死。又说这六团炁丹已深植玄窍，纵然用银针刺脉也无法导出，唯一的方法，就是找来属性不同的脏腑植体更换，或许能平衡中和。
“严忘一推我下了地窖，里面是一个极大的冰库，藏放着各种断肢、脏腑，也不知从何处搜集而来。他细细挑选了一番，给我上了麻药，开膛破肚，又迅速地替换缝针。蒙他回春妙手，自此丹田的疼痛果然消减了大半。王文卿在一旁更是看得目瞪口呆。

“禁军都指挥使被杀之事，很快就在汴京传得沸沸扬扬。严忘一见我闯了大祸，又是惊惧又是懊悔，但此时将我供出，也要背上窝藏之罪，于是只好将我们收容下来。
“我在他府里养了一个多月的伤，闲时也帮忙打打下手。他动刀‘夺胎换骨’时，我常常执灯观看，久而久之也瞧出了些门道。
“有一天，他外出诊病，几个樵夫抬着个大汉跑到府中，直呼救命。那汉子上山砍柴，被毒蛇咬中食指，昏迷不醒。众人惶急无措，一时半刻又来不及叫回严忘一，我当机立断，用刀切下他的右臂，挤尽毒血，灌下蛇药，又让王文卿从冰库中取来一截封冻的断臂，依样画葫芦地接上。
“断肢续接，除了骨肉要无缝相连之外，经脉、血管也需精准契合，嘿嘿，那时我哪有这等本事？但凭着这一多月的见闻与自己的领悟，居然也勉强接上了，虽然那人的手臂始终不能屈伸使劲，但他们对我已是千恩万谢。
“严忘一回来后听了极是惊讶，对我刮目相看。此后他动刀之时，常常让我在一旁牵线缝针，并不时地指点讲解，教我其中要诀。
“如此又过了一个多月，我伤势尽愈，对于这‘夺胎换骨’之术也学了不少。王文卿不住催我离开，我一来尚未探得妹子下落，二来正沉迷医术，对于寻找‘炼天石图’反倒没那般热切。
“那天夜里，我正睡得酣熟，忽然听见有人尖声大叫：‘严公死啦！严公死啦！’
“我惊醒起身，冲进严忘一的房中，只见他被逆鳞刀贯胸钉在床上，同榻的小妾也被割断喉咙，死状极惨。墙上鲜血淋漓，写了一行大字：‘杀人者李灵萼。’
“我又惊又怒，还以为是刘易知的余党得知我藏身在此，故意栽赃陷害，到后来才知道，原来竟是王文卿所为。他奶奶的，这小贼垂涎‘炼天石图’，又没胆子盗走‘指南珠’孤身前往，见老子流连不去，竟然下此毒手来断我后路。”
众道士听了又是一阵斥骂，林灵素毫不理会，续道：“严府众人又哭又骂，要拉我去见官。王文卿拔出逆鳞刀，挥舞着将众人逼退，冲出重围。事已至此，我只好趁夜逃出汴河水门，顺着司南珠所指的方向，朝西南而去。
“没几日，南唐李氏后人杀死禁军首领与大宋名医的事情便传遍天下，到处都是搜捕我们的捕快与禁军。我们不便再做乞丐打扮，路上恰好遇见几个云游的僧人，于是便偷了他们的百衲衣，剃光脑袋，扮成和尚。
“老子在金山寺里待了大半年，假扮和尚自是驾轻就熟，露不出半点破绽。顺着指南珠所向，一路有惊无险到了神农架。那时正值初冬，山下红叶似火，黄林如带，山上冰雪皑皑，青松如缀。
“刚想进山，忽听有人吟道：‘远上寒山石径斜，白云深处有人家。屡失南邻春事约，只今容有未开花。’抬头望去，一个乞丐斜背着短剑，坐在树上举着铁葫芦，仰头咕咕喝酒。
“他所吟的这四句诗，前半部分是唐朝杜牧所作，后半部分却是陈师道的诗。陈师道人称‘苏门六君子’，苏公在世时，常有唱酬往来。这两句诗由此人读来，却似另有所指。
“他抹了下嘴巴，又哈哈一笑，道：‘醉卧沙场君莫笑，古来征战几人回？你们这两个魔头东躲西逃了这么久，还想爽约到什么时候？来来来，跟老叫花子喝了这壶酒，斗个不死不休！’
“我还以为他说的‘两个魔头’是指我们，却听身后传来敖青青的笑声：‘臭叫花子，谁说我们在躲你了？你打又打不过我们，牛皮糖似的粘着不放，羞也不羞？’”

content_en:
Lin Lingsu said: "I put a knife to the bastard's neck and asked him if he still recognized me. He couldn't recognize me for a long time and shook his head repeatedly. I mentioned my sister and the pair of dragon and phoenix golden locks that he had snatched away, and then his face changed drastically and he begged for mercy. He said that my sister was sold into a brothel by Liu Yizhi, the commander of the Forbidden Army, and it was not his business.
"There was a 'buzzing' in my head, and my lungs almost exploded. I grabbed the bastard's neck and cut off the half of his ear that I had bitten off. The bastard screamed and peeed in fear. Damn it, I feel all the blood in my body rushing to the top of my head. I have never been so happy. The more he begs for mercy, the more I want to cut him to pieces!
"One knife after another, I gouged out his eyes, cut off his nose, chopped off his fingers and toes one by one, minced his internal organs, took them out, and threw them into the alley to feed wild dogs. It wasn't until I heard someone shouting: 'Killing! Killing!' 'The official is coming!' Then I stopped and slowly walked away.
“I wandered around Peach Blossom Cave, Tianshui Lane, and North and South Xiejie for another two days and two nights, trying to find out the girl’s whereabouts. The bastards who bullied me in the past, except for two who died early, were all skinned and cramped by me, and cut into pieces.
"Hey, seeing these bastards begging for mercy in fear, the refreshing feeling is really indescribable. If a real man is alive, if he can't be happy with his grudges, what's the point of living? It's a pity that I was too young at that time, and his attacks were too quick and heavy. I don't know that compared to being cut into pieces by a thousand cuts, people who can't live or die can't relieve their hatred more."
You couldn't see his expression in the darkness, but hearing him describe the details of the murders and torture methods with a weird smile, his voice was cold and sinister, which made your hair stand on end.
All the Taoist priests were even more terrified, thinking: "This guy will definitely get his revenge. If we let him escape again, none of us will survive."
Only Xu Xuan thought of those enemies who betrayed and framed the Xu family, and became furious and felt sad in his heart. He wished he could kill them all in pieces according to the law.
Lin Lingsu said: "I found out that Liu Yizhi's mistress was called Xiao Taohong, and she was the top name in Haitang Garden, so I waited at the entrance of Quyuan Street day and night. On the third night, the man finally came. After the second watch, I asked Wang Wenqing to watch the wind in the alley, turned into the yard, and climbed up to the second floor along the tree trunk.
"The dog thief surnamed Liu is also very naughty. He was sleeping soundly with his mistress in his arms. When he heard the noise, he immediately turned over and jumped up, throwing Xiao Taohong towards me. I stabbed the man to death with one knife, then slashed the chair that the thief was blocking with two more slashes, and cut off his right wrist.
"The dog thief rolled out of the window, yelling loudly, and several followers immediately ran out of the inner courtyard. Although I have practiced sword skills for several months, I am still neglected in actual combat. Being surrounded by these five Forbidden Army guards, I was a little nervous for a while. Fortunately, the Nilin sword was extremely sharp, and the sword, gun and stick were cut into pieces as soon as they collided.
"Lamps inside and outside the courtyard were lit one by one. Prostitutes, tortoises, and clients looked around and screamed. Someone even sounded a golden gong and shouted for help.
"Liu Yizhi stumbled out with his broken wrist in his hands. I wanted to catch up, but suddenly there was a sharp pain in my Dantian. I was only focused on revenge, and I forgot that it happened to be the seventh day. His moves were chaotic, and he was hit by a stick on the back. Then he was hit in the chest and right leg. The pain was unbearable and he fell to the ground. In the chaos, he swung his knife wildly, killing two people. There was another pain in his right shoulder, and he was nailed to the ground by a spear.
"The three people cheered in unison, raised their swords and were about to cut me down, when suddenly their bodies swayed and they all fell to the ground. I was so shocked and surprised that I had no time to think about it, so I pulled out my spear and rushed out the door reluctantly. But they saw the dog thief surnamed Liu huddled at the entrance of the alley, and Wang Wenqing stood aside with a look of horror on his face, holding the bloody half of the sword. Hehe, I passed on his sword skills, and it was finally not in vain.
"Liu Yizhi was stabbed in front of him, and he was dying. I grabbed him and asked him about the girl's whereabouts. The thief knew that I wasWhoever came behind was surprised and angry, coughing and laughing: "I gave your sister to a monk to be a temple prostitute. She was given a green lantern mat in the temple. The monks had little entertainment, and I don't know if she is alive to this day?" ’
"I was furious after hearing this and asked him which temple it was, but he laughed loudly, bumped his head against my knife edge, and killed himself. The sound of horse hooves in the distance was getting closer and closer, and at least a hundred forbidden troops were coming here. I was seriously injured, and the pain in my Dantian was overwhelming, and I couldn't take a step forward.
"Wang Wenqing carried me on his back and ran westward. His other abilities are ordinary, but his ability to escape is quite good. Passing Yongning Street, I vaguely remembered that Yan Wangyi lived nearby and that with his medical skills, he would be able to save my life, so I asked Madam Wang to turn around and head south.
"Although Yan Wangyi was timid and stingy and rarely interacted with others, he regarded Su Dongpo and Huang Luzhi as life-and-death friends. He loved the house and the crow, and he was also good to us schoolboys. He saw us jumping into the house covered in blood in the middle of the night, but he didn't even report to the official. He just hid me in the inner room in a panic and applied medicine on the wound.
"He took his pulse for a while, his brows furrowed deeper and deeper, and he said it was strange. He said that there were at least six groups of Qi Dan in my body that were conflicting with each other, and my internal organs were severely damaged. If this continued, the five elements would be in conflict with each other, and sooner or later the meridians would be severed and I would die. He also said that these six groups of Qi Dan have been deeply embedded in the mysterious orifices, and even if they are pricked with silver needles, they cannot be extracted. The only way is to find organ transplants with different properties and replace them, which may be able to balance and neutralize them.
"Yan Wang pushed me down to the cellar. Inside was a huge icehouse, which contained various severed limbs and internal organs collected from unknown sources. He carefully selected them, gave me anesthetic, disembowelled me, and quickly replaced the stitches. Thanks to his rejuvenating skills, the pain in my pubic area was reduced by most. Wang Wenqing looked on in shock.
"The murder of the commander of the Forbidden Army soon spread in Bianjing. When Yan Wang saw that I had caused a big disaster, he was frightened and regretful. However, if he confessed me at this time, he would be guilty of harboring me, so he had no choice but to take us in.
"I stayed in his house to recover from my injuries for more than a month, and I also helped with the beatings in my free time. When he was using the knife to "replace the body and bones," I often held a lamp to watch, and over time I also saw some tricks.
“One day, when he went out to see a doctor, some woodcutter carried a big man and ran to the house, calling for help. The man went up the mountain to chop firewood and was bitten by a poisonous snake on his index finger, causing him to fall unconscious. Everyone was in a panic, and there was no time to call Yan Wangyi back. I made a prompt decision, cut off his right arm with a knife, squeezed out the poisonous blood, drank the snake poison, and asked Wang Wenqing to get a frozen severed arm from the icehouse, and reattached it in the same manner.
"To reconnect a severed limb, in addition to the seamless connection of bones and flesh, the meridians and blood vessels also need to be accurately matched. Hey, how could I have such skills at that time? But with the knowledge and knowledge I have learned over the past month, I was able to barely connect it. Although the person's arm could not bend or stretch hard, they were extremely grateful to me.
"When Yan Wangyi came back, he was extremely surprised and looked at me with admiration. After that, when he performed the operation, he often asked me to hold the threads and stitches aside, and he would give me pointers and explanations from time to time, teaching me the key points.
"More than a month passed like this, my injuries were completely healed, and I also learned a lot about this 'reborn and reborn' technique. Wang Wenqing kept urging me to leave. Firstly, I had not yet found out the girl's whereabouts, and secondly, I was obsessed with medical skills, so I was not that eager to find the 'Heavenly Refining Stone Map'.
“That night, I was sleeping soundly when I suddenly heard someone screaming: ‘Gong Yan is dead! Duke Yan is dead! ’
"I woke up and rushed into Yan Wangyi's room. I saw that he was nailed to the bed with a Niscal knife pierced through his chest. The concubine who was sharing the same bed also had her throat cut. She died in a miserable state. There was blood dripping on the wall, and there was a line of big characters written on it: 'The murderer Li Ling'e.'
"I was shocked and angry. I thought it was Liu Yizhi's remnants who found out that I was hiding here and deliberately framed me. Later,Then I realized that it was actually Wang Wenqing who did it. It belongs to his grandmother. This little thief coveted the ‘Stone Map of Heaven Refining’, but he didn’t have the guts to steal the ‘Guide Bead’ and go alone. Seeing that I was lingering around, he actually decided to cut off my escape. "
After hearing this, the Taoist priests scolded me again, but Lin Lingsu ignored it and continued: "Everyone in the Yan Mansion cried and scolded me and wanted to drag me to see the official. Wang Wenqing pulled out the Nilin Dao, waved it to force everyone back, and rushed out of the encirclement. At this point, I had no choice but to escape from the water gate of the Bianhe River at night and head southwest in the direction pointed by Si Nanzhu.
"In a few days, the story of the descendants of the Li family of the Southern Tang Dynasty killing the leader of the Imperial Guard and the famous doctor of the Song Dynasty spread all over the world, and there were police officers and Imperial Guards hunting us everywhere. It was no longer convenient for us to dress up as beggars, so we happened to meet a few wandering monks on the road, so we stole their robes, shaved their heads, and dressed up as monks.
"I have been in Jinshan Temple for more than half a year, and I am very good at pretending to be a monk without showing any flaws. Following the direction of the guide bead, we arrived at Shennongjia without any danger. It was early winter at that time, and the red leaves at the foot of the mountain were like fire, the yellow forests were like ribbons, and the mountains were covered with ice and snow, and green pines were like dots.
"Just as I was about to enter the mountain, I suddenly heard someone singing: 'The stone path up the Hanshan Mountain is sloping, and there is a home deep in the white clouds. I have repeatedly missed the spring appointment in the south, but now it has not bloomed.' Looking up, I saw a beggar with a dagger slung across his back, sitting on a tree, holding an iron gourd, raising his head and drinking wine.
"The first half of the four lines of poetry he recited was written by Du Mu of the Tang Dynasty, while the second half was written by Chen Shidao. Chen Shidao was known as the "Six Gentlemen of Su Clan". When Su Gong was still alive, he often had singing and entertainment contacts. When this person reads these two poems, they seem to have other meanings.
"He wiped his mouth, laughed again, and said: 'Don't laugh, Lord, who is lying drunk on the battlefield. How many people have fought in ancient times? You two demons have been hiding for so long, how long do you want to break the promise? Come on, drink this pot of wine with the old beggar, and fight to the death!'
“I thought the ‘two devils’ he meant were us, but I heard Ao Qingqing’s laughter coming from behind: ‘Beggar, who said we were hiding from you? You can't beat us again and again. You stick to us like brown candy. Are you ashamed? ’”
